articles.title: Make in India achieved little but govt's 'Fake in India' continues: Cong on GDP numbers

This critique highlights ongoing political debate surrounding national economic data and policy effectiveness, suggesting a disconnect between official statistics and ground realities, relevant for understanding India's domestic policy landscape.
